title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
This week, S&P activity has maintained the same healthy momentum across all segments which has been enduringfor the past months. On dry, rates have been softer, showcasing a 43% lower m/m end of the week for the Capes at 29,500/day, a decline which is attributed to the reduced Chinese steel import demand, as mills are faced with thin margins and iron ore port inventories remain elevated. At the same time, data suggests congestion at Chinese discharge ports has been reduced, resulting in greater supply of tonnage.
